x: The crucial breakthrough was to contact one of the influential and financially powerful elected Members Committees of the G.L.C. - The Arts and Recreation Committee - chaired by Tony Banks with Peter Pitt as Vice Chairman.
A hastily prepared proposal, a presentation to the GLC's Arts & Recreation's Sports Committee(chaired by Peter Pitt) and we were given a maximum £14000 Grant for our size of Club.

Present too was our biggest supporter - Peter Pitt-who you will recall stepped in at the last minute to provide a GLC grant of £14000 when the development project was foundering due to cost escallation and the introduction of VAT mid way through the the building programme.
